description: The updated standard retry mode behavior previously available through the ``AWS_NEW_RETRIES_2026`` opt-in environment variable is now the default, and the ``AWS_NEW_RETRIES_2026`` environment variable has been removed. The standard retry mode now uses lower initial backoff delays (50ms base instead of 1s for non-throttling errors), honors the ``x-amz-retry-after`` response header for server-guided retry timing, adjusts retry behavior for long-polling operations, and uses updated retry quota costs.
